+class EventsController < ApplicationController
+  before_action :require_completed_profile
+  before_action :require_admin!, only: %i[new create edit update destroy]
+  before_action :set_event, only: %i[show edit update destroy ics]
+
+  def index
+    @events = Event.order(:starts_at)
+  end
+
+  def show
+  end
+
+  def new
+    @event = Event.new
+  end
+
+  def create
+    @event = Event.new(event_params)
+    if @event.save
+      redirect_to events_path, notice: "Event was created."
+    else
+      render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity
+    end
+  end
+
+  def edit
+  end
+
+  def update
+    if @event.update(event_params)
+      redirect_to event_path(@event), notice: "Event updated."
+    else
+      render :edit, status: :unprocessable_entity
+    end
+  end
+
+  def destroy
+    @event.destroy
+    redirect_to events_path, notice: "Event deleted."
+  end
+
+  def ics
+    calendar = <<~ICS
+      BEGIN:VCALENDAR
+      VERSION:2.0
+      PRODID:-//YourApp//EN
+      BEGIN:VEVENT
+      UID:event-#{@event.id}@yourapp.com
+      DTSTAMP:#{Time.now.utc.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")}
+      DTSTART:#{@event.starts_at.utc.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")}
+      DTEND:#{(@event.ends_at || @event.starts_at + 1.hour).utc.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")}
+      SUMMARY:#{@event.name}
+      DESCRIPTION:#{@event.description}
+      LOCATION:#{@event.location}
+      END:VEVENT
+      END:VCALENDAR
+    ICS
+
+    send_data calendar, type: "text/calendar", disposition: "attachment", filename: "#{@event.name.parameterize}.ics"
+    rescue StandardError => e
+      Rails.logger.error("ICS generation failed for event #{@event.id}: #{e.message}")
+      redirect_to event_path(@event), alert: "Couldn't generate the calendar file."
+  end
+
+  private
+
+  def set_event
+    @event = Event.find(params[:id])
+  end
+
+  def event_params
+    params.require(:event).permit(:name, :description, :starts_at, :ends_at, :location)
+  end
+
+  def require_admin!
+    unless current_member&.admin?
+      redirect_to events_path, alert: "Admins only."
+    end
+  end
+end

+  end

+
+    it "destroys dependent attendances when the member is destroyed" do

+      expect(build(:member)).not_to be_profile_completed
+    end

+  describe "#admin?" do

+      expect(build(:member, :admin).admin?).to be true

+    it "is false for a member with a non-admin role" do

+  describe ".from_google" do

+                   first_name: "Mem", last_name: "Ber", role: admin_role,
+                   profile_completed_at: Time.current)
+  end
+  let(:event) do
+    Event.create!(name: "Meeting", description: "Details",
+                  starts_at: Time.utc(2026, 10, 1, 10, 0),
+                  ends_at:   Time.utc(2026, 10, 1, 11, 0),
+                  location: "Room 1")
+  end
+
+  before { sign_in member }
+
+  describe "Sunny: member views event and downloads calendar file" do
+    it "shows the event details" do
+      get event_path(event)
+      expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
+      expect(response.body).to include("Meeting")
+      expect(response.body).to include("Room 1")
+      expect(response.body).to include("Details")
+    end
+
+    it "returns a valid .ics file with the event's data" do
+      get ics_event_path(event, format: :ics)
+

+      expect(response.body).to include("SUMMARY:Meeting")
+      expect(response.body).to include("LOCATION:Room 1")
+      expect(response.body).to include("DTSTART:20261001T100000Z")
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "Rainy: event was edited after the page loaded" do
+    it "returns the latest details from the database" do
+      get event_path(event)
+      expect(response.body).to include("Room 1")
+
+      event.update!(location: "Room 2", name: "Meeting (updated)")
+
+      get event_path(event)
+      expect(response.body).to include("Room 2")
+      expect(response.body).to include("Meeting (updated)")
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "Rainy: calendar generation fails" do
+    it "redirects back to the event with an alert and keeps details visible" do
+      allow_any_instance_of(EventsController)
+        .to receive(:send_data).and_raise(StandardError, "boom")
+
+      get ics_event_path(event, format: :ics)
+
+      expect(response).to redirect_to(event_path(event))
+      follow_redirect!
+      expect(CGI.unescapeHTML(response.body)).to include("Couldn't generate the calendar file")
+      expect(response.body).to include("Meeting")
+      expect(response.body).to include("Room 1")
+    end
+  end
+end
